note: Preliminary engineering materials produced for the proposal. Where a slide reports results, the measured experiments in this repository supersede it — see docs/PROGRESS.md and the Experiments page.

slides.title: System Concept Sketch
slides.summary: The whole idea on one page: a rover leaving a facility, four candidate access networks reaching one gateway, and the observe / predict / prepare loop between them.

slides.title: Route & Coverage Drawing
slides.summary: The four zones the route crosses — facility dock, campus, field corridor, remote hills — and where each network is available, including the handoff overlaps.

slides.title: Handoff Logic Flow
slides.summary: Observe, Predict, Prepare, Steer, Explain as a state flow, with the inputs each stage reads and the audit record the last one writes.

slides.title: Prediction Calculation
slides.summary: The heuristic worked by hand: two RSSI samples, a slope, a three-second extrapolation, and the threshold crossing that triggers preparation.

slides.title: Link Selection Score
slides.summary: The weighted utility that ranks candidate paths, with a worked comparison between two links.

slides.title: Testbed Architecture
slides.summary: How a run is produced: scenario generator, traffic generator, the network layer, and receiver-side logs as the only source of metrics.

slides.title: Scenario Matrix & Assumptions
slides.summary: The six scenarios, what each one is designed to test, and the assumptions shared across all of them.

slides.title: Baseline Comparison Results
slides.summary: Early comparison of B0, B1 and P1 on interruption, deadline misses and handoffs.

slides.title: Application-Level Test Results
slides.summary: Early receiver-side figures: video stall, telemetry freshness, one-way delay and satellite share.

slides.title: References & Evidence Notes
slides.summary: Literature and tools the design draws on, and the list of materials making up the evidence package.
